archimate:Goal.name: Care Transition Management: Structured Handoffs and Continuity Protocols Between Care Settings and Providers
archimate:Goal.documentation: Care transition management - Structured handoffs and continuity protocols between care settings and providers. Motivation: Since we are under the Quality and Continuity of Care Goal, it is important to consider this subgoal as main driver for patient safety, avoid redundant care (duplication of tests) and patient care continuity gaps.
